meta.description: TR-11, Blueprint §10 flow 3. Daily 09:00: GET checkins/missed-yesterday (no `date` -> defaults to YESTERDAY server-side) direct-to-platform under wf:reports-morning-escalation (company_admin). The read groups yesterday's auto_missed check-ins by UNIT and resolves each unit's own lead(s) server-side ('whoever holds manager AND is a current member of that same unit' -- checkins.controller.ts's missedYesterday, the same in-app narrowing TR-09 already applies elsewhere, since no per-org-node manager-grant Cerbos primitive exists yet). This flow does ZERO grouping/routing logic itself -- it only fans out ONE in-app notification per (unit, lead) pair the platform already resolved, which is what keeps this 'the right lead, never a broadcast': a unit with no resolvable lead is skipped here, not escalated to someone outside it. A day with no misses returns `byUnit: []` and this flow delivers nothing (same quiet-by-construction shape as the eod-reminder flow). Env: PLATFORM_URL, PLATFORM_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID, HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, recipientId: $json.recipientId, type: "checkin_missed_escalation", payload: { unitNodeId: $json.unitNodeId, count: $json.count, date: $json.date } } } }) }}
